summary: Iteration 2 of v051_lopunny_crustle: fixed the two iteration-1 regressions (deck consistency cut, attach-priority tempo theft). Deck.csv variant A (cut Full Metal Lab 3->2 + Jumbo Ice Cream 3->2 to restore Poke Pad to 4) chosen over variant B (cut Night Stretcher instead) after both were measured N=1000 across all 3 references, not just the N=500 mirror spot-check -- variant A dominates on every axis. main.py gated Lopunny evolve/attach-priority behind _lopunny_secondary_gate(turn>=5 OR Archaludon-ex-discard-with-real-Duraludon-investment OR Duraludon-KO'd-with-none-in-play), closing a loophole found during the smoke test where the naive 'attacker not in play' / 'Archaludon ex in discard' checks fired vacuously turn 1-2 (Archaludon ex routinely gets discarded as Ultra Ball fuel by turn 2 in the existing Crustle plan, which avoids evolving to ex entirely against Crustle).

deck_variant_selection.variant_A: Poke Pad 2->4, Jumbo Ice Cream 3->2, Full Metal Lab 3->2 (keeps Night Stretcher at 3)
deck_variant_selection.variant_B: Poke Pad 2->4, Jumbo Ice Cream 3->2, Night Stretcher 3->2 (keeps Full Metal Lab at 3)

n500_mirror_screen.note: B looked closer to 0.5 on this first N=500 screen -> initially chosen

n1000_full_reassessment.verdict: Variant A dominates B on ALL THREE references at N=1000 (mirror closer to 0.5, both Crustle refs higher WR) -- switched final deck.csv to variant A. The N=500 mirror-only screen was misleading; picking on Crustle-ref preservation, not just mirror consistency, matters and requires the larger N.

main_py_gate_bug_found_and_fixed.bug: _lopunny_secondary_gate's 'attacker lost' condition (`not any(...) in play`) was vacuously true turn 1 (before Duraludon has even been played from the opening hand), and the 'Archaludon-ex-discard-override-fired' condition (bare `ARCHALUDON_EX in discard_ids`) fires almost immediately in most Crustle games because Archaludon ex is dead weight vs Crustle (never evolved to) and gets discarded as ordinary Ultra Ball fuel around turn 1-2 as part of the EXISTING Crustle plan -- confirmed via smoke-test [dbg] trace inspection (results/gates/traces/v051b/smoke).
main_py_gate_bug_found_and_fixed.fix: 'attacker lost' now requires DURALUDON actually present in the discard pile (KO evidence, same signal NIGHT_STRETCHER's has_urgent check already uses) AND none in play. 'Archaludon-ex-abandoned' now additionally requires Duraludon already carrying 2+ energy in play (real primary-plan investment, not just incidental fuel-discard).
main_py_gate_bug_found_and_fixed.verification: post-fix smoke test (out/v051b_smoke/smoke_stderr_v3.log, 20 games vs v009a_crustle): earliest 'energy priority (secondary win-con)' turn=4 (down from turn=1 pre-fix); earliest evolve turn=3, in a game where Duraludon already had 2 energy by then (legitimate 'primary plan under way' trigger, not vacuous). WR on this 20-game smoke = 0.95 (19W-1L).

v007_crustle.acceptance: parity or better vs v050 baseline 0.7875, CI intersect
v007_crustle.result: PASS (marginal) -- single-run CIs overlap comfortably; combined N=2000 CIs still overlap but narrowly (z=2.25, borderline p~0.025), consistent delta approx -3pp

task_specified_n500.result: FAIL at the task-specified N=500 protocol

v009a_crustle.acceptance: parity or CI intersect (by analogy with v007's stated criterion)
v009a_crustle.result: FAIL -- real, reproducible regression. Both the task-specified N=500 spot check (CI disjoint) AND a higher-powered combined-N=2000-per-side re-test (z=4.78, p<0.0001, delta approx -5.8pp: 0.847 baseline vs 0.789 candidate) confirm this is not sampling noise. v009a_crustle (the stronger local Crustle reference) is hurt more than v007_crustle by the deck-composition cost (Jumbo Ice Cream/Full Metal Lab cuts) even with the tempo-theft bug fixed and deck variant A chosen over B.

overall_verdict_reason: Mirror-consistency and v007_crustle tempo-theft regressions from iteration 1 are fixed (mirror CI now contains 0.5; v007_crustle CI overlaps, though narrowly under closer scrutiny). Regression slice (v017/v044) is clean. BUT a real, statistically robust regression persists against v009a_crustle -- the stronger of the two local Crustle references -- confirmed both at the task-specified N=500 protocol (CI disjoint) and via a higher-powered N=2000-per-side re-test (z=4.78, p<0.0001). Per the task's own decision rule (fail = regression remains -> close the direction, fold Crustle definitively), this is a FAIL. The Lopunny-pierce mechanism itself remains engine-verified and real (Spiky Hopper 160 vs Crustle's Rock Inn wall), but its net cost to the existing, already-strong Crustle plan (deck-slot dilution + residual scoring interactions) outweighs its upside against local references; live opponents' Crustle decks may differ enough for this verdict not to generalize perfectly, but per the pre-agreed acceptance bar this direction is closed.
